events.title: The first demo of the game is about to be available for download
events.summary: "The Rule of Adult," is about to release a DEMO download. This is a horror-themed story game with nurturing and RPG gameplay elements. Players will take on the role of new employees trying to survive under the company's strange rules. Through daily training, players can improve their stats, enter the digital world to fight other enemies, and uncover the company's hidden secrets.
